1	## Summary
2	
3	The `HasRigidPushforward` gate went from **four open leaves to one open statement**. Two leaves are now theorems, the third is reduced, and the infrastructure the third needs also landed. Seven new sorry-free modules (~2,700 lines), eight commits. There is deliberately **no** `instance : HasRigidPushforward` — so the task stays queued, as its own brief requires.
4	
5	The unlock was not cohomological. Both candidate anchors for the H⁰-finiteness leaf bottomed out at the same fact: the ℙ¹ chart ring had to be **free**, and the tree only had it **spanned**. The missing half was already written in the sibling project over a field, and no step of it uses the field hypothesis — one cross-project search replaced a session of re-derivation.
6	
7	## Progress
8	
9	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartRing.lean`: new, 408 lines. `p1AwayAlgEquiv` — the chart ring of the integral model `Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁]` is a polynomial ring, over **any** commutative base ring. Also fills a mathlib gap (`HomogeneousLocalization` as an algebra over the *base*, not just the degree-zero part).
10	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartSections.lean`: new, 457 lines. `Γ(ℙ¹_k, D₊(Xᵢ)) ≃ₐ[k] k[T]`. The injectivity the tree lacked, via a retraction from the `CommRingCat` section-ring pushout — its compatibility square is free because `Γ(⊤_Scheme)` is initial.
11	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Topology.lean`: new, 173 lines. Domains → `IsReduced` + `IrreducibleSpace` → `IsIntegral`, in ~30 lines rather than by chart-chasing.
12	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`: new, 619 lines. **Leaf 3 closed** — `p1RankIdentity_proved`, for *every* `k`-algebra (the `FiniteType` the gate assumes is not needed).
13	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`: new, 441 lines. Leaf 4 reduced by affine-target descent (Stacks 01I8) from "no infrastructure at all" to one module-level bijectivity.
14	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean`: new, 441 lines. The 02KG chart comparison at an arbitrary affine base change, plus the Čech square on **kernels** — what the route called "the genuinely missing piece".
15	- `Picard/RigidPushforwardInstance.lean`: new, ~160 lines. `instIsIntegralP1OverLeft`; `locallyFree` unconditional; `hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange` — the gate from one hypothesis.
16	- `Picard/{Gate,Frontier,Rank,AffineDescent}.lean`: docstring corrections only, in two audit rounds.
17	
18	Every module: sorry-free, single-module `lake build` green, `#print axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
19	
20	## Issues
21	
22	- **Four of my modules were swept into another run's blanket integration commit** while in flight, so they carry the wrong task's trailers. Contents verified byte-identical; commit `3636b5ea2` is the record. Saved as memory — `git commit` answering "no changes added" does *not* mean the work was lost.
23	- **Two audit rounds found six overstatements, three of them in files the first repair commit had already edited.** The worst was false, not merely loose: "`hsurj` is subsumed by the `kerBaseChange` hypothesis" (counterexample `d = 0`), which would have licensed deleting a real hypothesis. A later round found the `k[x]` counterexample witnesses `hproj` *alone* — `hsurj`, `hfin`, `hbc` all hold in it — while the heading claimed three.
24	- `RigidPushforwardChartBaseChange.lean` is not yet in the root roll-up (out of my write set); requested from ajc-truth. All six earlier modules are rooted.
25	- Inbox is over its advisory limits (17 memories vs. cap 10); janitor escalated a concrete CLI fix rather than deleting live items.
26	- Heavy contention — three runs building concurrently, load ~50, swap exhausted. Several builds took 20–30× their real elaboration time.
27	
28	## Why I stopped
29	
30	**Partly advanced, deliberately not complete.** The done-criterion requires a genuine non-sorry instance producer, and `RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` has no producer — writing `instance : HasRigidPushforward` anyway is exactly the failure mode this task's own history warns about. Status left unset so it returns to the queue.
31	
32	Verification I ran before claiming: `#check` on both headline theorems shows only the three AJC-curve hypotheses plus the algebra data — nothing relocated into a producer-less instance binder — and both compile end-to-end from those hypotheses alone. A fresh-context review refuted the vacuity worry three ways (ℙ¹ is nonempty, is not a point, is not 𝔸¹) and confirmed the 4→3→1 arithmetic by printing signatures rather than reading docstrings. It also flagged, correctly, that the clean axiom check on `hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange` carries **no** information, since it quantifies over a producer-less statement.
33	
34	## Next
35	
36	Attack `RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` and nothing else. Read `RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`'s docstring first — it carries the route *and* four corrections to it. With the chart bricks landed, what remains is assembly plus one congruence helper: moving `moduleSectionDiffBase` statements from `π_A ≫ p` to `q` across the propositional `finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd`, where the module structures sit inside the type. One focused session, and the risk is Lean engineering, not mathematics.

114	  let E := 𝒰.globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase f M
115	  let E' := (𝒰.preimage g').globalSectionsEquivKerModuleSectionDiffBase f'
116	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)
117	  let T := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections f M
118	  let T' := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardTopEquivBaseSections f'
119	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)
120	  let s : TensorProduct Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)
121	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) ≃+
122	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M),
123	        (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) :=
124	    (TensorProduct.congr (LinearEquiv.refl Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(Y', ⊤)) (T.trans E)).toAddEquiv.trans
125	      (Ξ.trans (E'.symm.trans T'.symm).toAddEquiv)
126	  refine ⟨s.toAddMonoidHom, ?_, s.bijective⟩
127	  intro b x
128	  -- the canonical base map commutes with restriction to either chart
129	  have hres : ∀ (W₀ : X.Opens) (hW₀ : W₀ ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens))
130	      (hW'' : g' ⁻¹ᵁ W₀ ≤ f' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y'.Opens)),
131	      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW'').op).hom
132	          (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M e' x)
133	        = pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W₀))
134	          ((M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW₀).op).hom x) :=
135	    fun W₀ hW₀ hW'' => pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_res' g' M e'
136	      (le_refl (g' ⁻¹ᵁ W₀)) hW₀ hW'' x
137	  have key : E' (T' (b • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj
138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M), (⊤ : Y'.Opens)) from
139	      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g' M e' x))) = Ξ (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, ⊤)] (E (T x))) := by
140	    rw [_root_.map_smul T' b, _root_.map_smul E' b]
141	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
142	    rw [hΞ b (E (T x))]
143	    exact Prod.ext
144	      (congrArg (fun z => (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.U₁) le_top).hom b • z)
145	        (hres 𝒰.U₁ le_top le_top))
146	      (congrArg (fun z => (f'.appLE (⊤ : Y'.Opens) (g' ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒰.U₂) le_top).hom b • z)

150	  rw [hsval, ← key, E'.symm_apply_apply, T'.symm_apply_apply]

152	/-! ## §2. The gate's remaining statement, for an AJC curve -/
153	
154	section AJC
155	
156	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
157	
158	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
159	-- Elaborating the engine application unfolds two nested pullback squares and the full
160	-- `letI` dictionary of the preimage cover.
161	/-- **`RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange` is a theorem.**  For the AJC curve `C/k` and every
162	finitely generated `k`-algebra `A`, the formation of `Γ(C_A, L)` for an invertible `L` with
163	fibrewise `h¹ = 0` commutes with every ring map `A → A'`.
164	
165	The Čech `H⁰`-purity fed to §1 is obtained on the 2-affine cover
166	`(p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage π_A` of `C_A` — the preimage under the finite (hence
167	affine) `π_A : C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A` of the standard 2-chart cover of `ℙ¹_A` — from two inputs:
168	
169	* **surjectivity** of its Čech differential, which is the *first* conjunct of the ℙ¹ engine
170	  `p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing_of_isIntegral` applied to `(π_A)_* L`.  No
171	  transport is needed: `AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionDiff_pushforward` is `rfl` and
172	  `moduleSectionDiffBase`'s underlying function *is* `moduleSectionDiff`, so the two
173	  surjectivity statements are the same proposition — in particular the propositional
174	  `q = π_A ≫ p` never has to be crossed;
175	* **flatness** of `Γ(L, U₁ ⊓ U₂)` over `Γ(Spec A, ⊤)`, which is `CoherentSheafFlat q L` read at
176	  the pair `(⊤, U₁ ⊓ U₂)` (`flat_baseSections_of_coherentSheafFlat`) — stated for `q` from the
177	  start, so again no transport.
178	
179	`bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective` then gives purity at `q`'s own module structures.  (The
180	alternative recorded in `Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean` — instantiating the engine's
181	*fourth* conjunct instead — avoids the flatness obligation but has to move the whole `letI`
182	dictionary from `p` and the pushforward module to `q` and `L`; flatness is free here, so this
183	route is shorter.)
184	
185	The ℙ¹ engine's `H⁰`-finiteness anchor is `IsIntegral (ℙ¹_k)`
186	(`Adelic.instIsIntegralP1OverLeft`), so the two fields of the gate are not independent — as
187	`Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`'s dependency warning records. -/
188	theorem rigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange_proved
189	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
190	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
191	    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] :
192	    RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange C A := by
193	  intro L hL h1 A' _ φ e'
194	  haveI := hL.isFinitePresentation
195	  haveI : IsFinite (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C) := isFinite_finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C
196	  haveI := pushforward_finiteMapToP1BaseChange_isFinitePresentation A C L hL
197	  -- the ℙ¹ engine, applied to the finite pushforward `(π_A)_* L`
198	  have hengine := p1Cech_h0_baseChange_of_fibrewise_h1_vanishing_of_isIntegral A
199	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L)
200	    (pushforward_finiteMapToP1BaseChange_coherentSheafFlat A C L hL)
201	    (p1CechFibrewiseBridge_proved A
202	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).obj L) inferInstance
203	      (fun t => pushforward_finiteMapToP1BaseChange_fiberH1 A C L t hL (h1 t)))
204	  -- the module dictionary on `C_A` for the preimage cover
205	  letI c1 := (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule
206	    L ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₁
207	  letI c2 := (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule
208	    L ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₂
209	  letI c0 := (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).baseSectionsModule
210	    L (((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₁ ⊓
211	      ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₂)
212	  -- surjectivity of the Čech differential of the preimage cover: the same proposition
213	  have hd : Function.Surjective
214	      ⇑(((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage
215	          (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).moduleSectionDiffBase
216	        (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) L) :=
217	    hengine.1
218	  -- flatness of the overlap sections, read off `CoherentSheafFlat q L`
219	  haveI : Subsingleton ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
220	    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
221	  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat C.hom := inferInstance
222	  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat
223	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) := inferInstance
224	  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of A), ⊤)
225	      Γ(L, ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₁ ⊓
226	        ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).U₂) :=
227	    Scheme.flat_baseSections_of_coherentSheafFlat _ L
228	      (Scheme.coherentSheafFlat_of_isLocallyTrivial_of_flat _ hL)
229	      ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)).isAffineOpen_inf
230	  haveI : IsAffineHom (pullback.fst
231	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
232	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
233	    MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsAffineHom) _ _ inferInstance
234	  exact exists_gammaBaseChange_of_kerPure (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)
235	    ((p1BaseChangeCoverSquare A).preimage (finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C)) L
236	    (fun B _ _ => AlgebraicJacobian.TwoTerm.bijective_kerBaseChange_of_surjective hd B) e'
237	
238	/-! ## §3. The gate, as an instance -/
239	
240	/-- **The B3 gate is a theorem.**  For the AJC curve — smooth of relative dimension one, proper,
241	geometrically integral over `k` — `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C` holds.
242	
243	Both fields are now unconditional: `locallyFree` is
244	`Adelic.rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_proved` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardInstance.lean`) and
245	`baseChange` is `Adelic.rigidPushforwardBaseChange_of_gamma`
246	(`Picard/RigidPushforwardAffineDescent.lean`) fed by `rigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange_proved`
247	of §2.
248	
249	`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean`'s class docstring anticipated exactly this — "no instances
250	anywhere in the tree — supplied as a hypothesis by consumers and discharged by the full B3 proof
251	session".  This is that instance; the `[HasRigidPushforward C]` binders on the three extraction
252	theorems now synthesize for an AJC curve, as §4 witnesses. -/
253	instance instHasRigidPushforwardOfCurve
254	    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
255	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
256	    Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C :=
257	  hasRigidPushforward_of_gammaBaseChange C
258	    (fun A _ _ _ => rigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange_proved C A)
259	
260	/-! ## §4. The B3 headlines, unconditionally
261	
262	The three extraction theorems of `Picard/RigidPushforward.lean` §3–§4 carry a
263	`[HasRigidPushforward C]` binder.  Restated here for an AJC curve *without* that binder — the
264	gate is synthesized by §3, not assumed.  These are the honest "the consumers synthesize"
265	witnesses: if §3 were absent, none of the three would elaborate. -/
266	
267	section Headlines
268	
269	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
270	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
271	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
272	variable (L : (Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Modules)
273	
274	/-- **B3 local freeness, unconditional.**  For an invertible `L` on `C_A` with fibrewise
275	`h¹ = 0` at all scheme points, `q_* L` is free of rank `h⁰(C_t, L_t)` near every `t : Spec A`. -/
276	theorem rigidPushforward_locallyFree
277	    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
278	    (h1 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
279	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t)
280	    (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
281	    ∃ U : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens, t ∈ U ∧
282	      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj
283	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
284	            (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L) ≅
285	        _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
286	          (ULift.{u} (Fin ((pullback.snd C.hom
287	            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 L t)))) :=
288	  Scheme.pushforward_locallyFree_of_h1_vanishing C A L hL h1 t
289	
290	/-- **B3 base change, unconditional.**  Under the same hypotheses the formation of `q_* L`
291	commutes with every ring map `A → A'` — no finiteness, flatness or noetherian condition on
292	`A'`. -/
293	theorem rigidPushforward_baseChange
294	    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
295	    (h1 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
296	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t)
297	    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') :
298	    IsIso (pushforwardBaseChangeMap
299	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
300	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
301	      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
302	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
303	      (pullback.fst (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
304	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
305	      pullback.condition L) :=
306	  Scheme.pushforward_baseChange_of_h1_vanishing C A L hL h1 A' φ
307	
308	/-- **The B3 rank-one corollary, unconditional** (Kleiman §5).  If in addition `h⁰ ≡ 1` then
309	`q_* L` is an invertible sheaf on `Spec A`.  This is the implemented route from a line bundle on
310	the family to the rigidified data the Picard campaign consumes. -/
311	theorem rigidPushforward_isLocallyTrivial
312	    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
313	    (h1 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
314	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).FiberH1Vanishing L t)
315	    (h0 : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of A),
316	      (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).fiberH0 L t = 1) :
317	    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
318	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
319	        (pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))).obj L) :=
320	  Scheme.pushforward_isLocallyTrivial_of_h1_vanishing C A L hL h1 h0
321	
322	end Headlines
323	
324	end AJC
325	
326	end Adelic
327	
328	end AlgebraicGeometry
